Package net.maswag.falcaun

package net.maswag.falcaun
FalCAuN - Falsification of Cyber-Physical Systems via Automata Learning.

This package contains the system-under-test (SUT) interfaces, which are the main extension points of FalCAuN: NumericSUL for systems executed step by step with discrete-time signals and ContinuousNumericSUL for systems that also expose continuous-time outputs. Backends such as Simulink and Python implement these interfaces in their own modules.

The other abstractions are organized in the following subpackages.

  • net.maswag.falcaun.signal: concrete input/output signals and derived signals.
  • net.maswag.falcaun.abstraction: the mappings between concrete signals and the finite abstract alphabets used by automata learning, e.g., SignalDiscretizer.
  • net.maswag.falcaun.temporal: STL/LTL specifications, their robustness semantics, and the lists of specifications to falsify.
  • net.maswag.falcaun.oracle: membership and equivalence oracles, including the robustness-guided equivalence testing.
  • net.maswag.falcaun.verification: the black-box checking process combining the above, e.g., NumericSULVerifier, and its result VerificationResult.

A typical use is: implement or obtain a NumericSUL, define a SignalDiscretizer (e.g., NumericSULMapper), parse the specifications with STLFactory into an AdaptiveSTLList, and run a NumericSULVerifier with some equivalence oracles.

ArgParser is the option parser of the legacy command-line interface.
